import base64, json, pathlib, hashlib, subprocess, tempfile, time
from urllib.parse import quote

repo="BestNameYet/Terminals"
prefix="workspaces/codespace-mcp-srs-design/expression-inventory"
def run(args, cwd=None, timeout=180):
    p=subprocess.run(args,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=timeout,cwd=cwd)
    if p.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError("Command failed: "+str(args)+", stderr="+p.stderr[-1200:]+", stdout="+p.stdout[-300:])
    return p.stdout.strip()
def gh(method,endpoint,obj=None):
    args=["gh","api","--method",method,"repos/"+repo+"/"+endpoint]
    if obj is not None:args+=["--input","-"]
    p=subprocess.run(args,text=True,capture_output=True,input=json.dumps(obj) if obj is not None else None,timeout=90)
    if p.returncode:raise RuntimeError(method+" "+endpoint+": "+p.stderr[-900:])
    return json.loads(p.stdout)
def getraw(p):
    f=gh("GET","contents/"+quote(p,safe="/")+"?ref=main")
    return base64.b64decode(f["content"])
def asjson(o):
    return (json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n").encode("utf-8")

task=json.loads(getraw("Tasks/User Prompt Task Queue/user-prompt-task-1794196167.json"))
programs=[a["javascript"] for a in task["amendments"] if isinstance(a,dict) and a.get("name")=="JavaScript expression inventory collector"]
assert len(programs)==1
script=programs[0]
assert hashlib.sha256(script.encode()).hexdigest()=="77a6f3a747dfdc7ed7c2c607cedbfb0007fbb973238cf8a030ba5f1f91e3b195"
assert pathlib.Path("workspaces/codespace-mcp-srs-design/AGENTS.md").is_file()

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
    root=pathlib.Path(temp)
    (root/"collect-expressions.js").write_text(script,encoding="utf-8")
    run(["node","--check",str(root/"collect-expressions.js")])
    pkg={
      "name":"codespace-mcp-expression-inventory",
      "version":"1.0.0","private":True,"type":"commonjs",
      "description":"Babel-based JavaScript expression AST collector",
      "devDependencies":{
          "@babel/parser":"^7.28.0",
          "@babel/traverse":"^7.28.0",
          "@babel/types":"^7.28.0"
      }
    }
    (root/"package.json").write_bytes(asjson(pkg))
    run(["npm","install","--package-lock-only","--ignore-scripts","--no-audit","--no-fund"],cwd=root)
    lock=(root/"package-lock.json").read_bytes()
    assert json.loads(lock)["lockfileVersion"]>=3
    run(["npm","ci","--ignore-scripts","--no-audit","--no-fund"],cwd=root)
    (root/"sample.js").write_text("const n=3; function calc(x) { return x * n; } console.log(calc(4));\n")
    (root/"sample.json").write_bytes(asjson({"rows":[{"relative_file_path":"sample.js","repository":"Fixture/Test"}]}))
    run(["node",str(root/"collect-expressions.js"),str(root/"sample.json"),str(root),str(root/"out")],cwd=root)
    manifest=json.loads((root/"out"/"manifest.json").read_text())
    assert manifest["files"][0]["status"]=="ok",manifest
    rows=json.loads(pathlib.Path(manifest["files"][0]["json"]).read_text())["expressions"]
    assert len(rows)>=5
    assert any(r["outside_function"] for r in rows)
    assert any(r["inside_function_definition"] and r["enclosing_function_name"]=="calc" for r in rows)
    srs="""# JavaScript Expression Collector — SRS

A Node.js command-line utility in the Codespace MCP design workspace. Input: a JSON, CSV, or newline-delimited file-path list, optional source root, and optional output directory. The program reads each inventoried JavaScript file, optionally verifies its Git blob SHA-1, parses its source once with @babel/parser, and walks the AST with @babel/traverse. For each expression node it records the source slice, AST node type, line and column span, whether it is a standalone expression statement, and its enclosing function name/type/span or absence thereof. Nested expressions are separate records. Semantic grouping/classification beyond Babel node types is not performed.

The program writes separate JSON and CSV tables per successful JavaScript input and a manifest covering all input entries, including non-JavaScript skips, parse errors, and zero-expression files. If any JavaScript file fails, the program returns a nonzero exit code after writing the manifest. The planned/manual GitHub Actions entrypoint checks out the input source repository/ref, uses npm ci for its Babel dependencies, invokes this program, and uploads the result directory as an Actions artifact. This design concerns JavaScript files; other languages require separate parsers.

Acceptance: Node syntax validation succeeds. A fixture with both top-level and function-body expressions yields AST records containing the corresponding enclosing-function relationships. Every input row is represented in the output manifest.
"""
    projection={
      "schema":"codespace-mcp.expression-collector.srs.v1",
      "source":"SRS.md",
      "input":{"file_list":["json","csv","txt"],"source_root":"path","output_dir":"path"},
      "dependencies":["@babel/parser","@babel/traverse","@babel/types"],
      "behavior":["read_every_input_row","skip_non_js_rows_explicitly","verify_git_blob_sha1_when_given","parse_javascript_once","walk_each_expression_ast_node","record_source_location_type_and_function_context","retain_per_file_errors","nonzero_exit_for_errors"],
      "output":{"csv":"per_file","json":"per_file","manifest":"all_input_rows"},
      "semantic_classifier":"not_implemented_beyond_ast_type",
      "entrypoint":"collect-expressions.js",
      "acceptance":["node_check","fixture_ast_context","complete_manifest"]
    }
    files={
      prefix+"/collect-expressions.js":script.encode("utf-8"),
      prefix+"/package.json":(root/"package.json").read_bytes(),
      prefix+"/package-lock.json":lock,
      prefix+"/SRS.md":srs.encode("utf-8"),
      prefix+"/SRS.agent.json":asjson(projection)
    }
    for dest in files:
        try:gh("GET","contents/"+quote(dest,safe="/")+"?ref=main")
        except RuntimeError as exc:
            if "HTTP 404" not in str(exc):raise
        else:raise RuntimeError("Already exists, refusing overwrite: "+dest)
    blobs=[]
    for dest,contents in files.items():
        response=gh("POST","git/blobs",{"encoding":"base64","content":base64.b64encode(contents).decode("ascii")})
        blobs.append({"path":dest,"mode":"100644","type":"blob","sha":response["sha"]})
    for attempt in range(5):
        head=gh("GET","git/ref/heads/main")["object"]["sha"]
        tree=gh("GET","git/commits/"+head)["tree"]["sha"]
        newtree=gh("POST","git/trees",{"base_tree":tree,"tree":blobs})["sha"]
        commit=gh("POST","git/commits",{"message":"Add Codespace MCP JavaScript expression collector and npm dependencies","tree":newtree,"parents":[head]})["sha"]
        try:
            gh("PATCH","git/refs/heads/main",{"sha":commit,"force":False})
            break
        except RuntimeError:
            if attempt==4:raise
            time.sleep(attempt+1)
    for dest,contents in files.items():
        assert getraw(dest)==contents,"Readback mismatch: "+dest
    print(json.dumps({
        "result":"VERIFIED",
        "commit":commit,
        "paths":list(files),
        "node_check":"passed",
        "npm_ci":"passed",
        "fixture_ast_records":len(rows),
        "fixture_file_status":manifest["files"][0]["status"]
    }))
